The Senior Tooling Engineer is expected to ensure the most up to date technologies are utilized to continuously improve our product, meeting our customer’s expectations and promote innovations, continuous improvements to all Structural Product divisions. The Senior Tooling Engineer has input into the short- and long-term strategic tooling plans. The Senior tooling engineer will also manage and lead Magna’s Center of Excellence (C.O.E.) to provide best practices in the metal forming section for all forming sections. Maintain and improve documents on the C.O.E.The Senior Tooling Engineer is responsible for new tooling/fixture buy off at vendors and will also assist production assembly tooling when required. The Senior Tooling Engineer will participate &amp; lead the design and costing activities in N.B.(New Buisness). The senior tooling engineer will analyse and approve tool strip layouts for optimization of material &amp; forming simulations. The Senior Tooling Engineer will support all S.P. divisions in North America.</p><p>Manangement of the tooling data base is required for all North America tools, this will include audits at suppliers and Magna divisions in North America.</p><p>The Senior Tooling Engineer will also support Cam-Slide assembly tooling when required.</p><p>KPI’s reported out weekly.</p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p>Essential Duties and Responsibilities</p><p></p><ul><li>Ensure budgets and objectives are achieved and/or exceeded with respect to tooling.</li><li>Responsible for forecasting and budgeting related to tooling for engineering changes and New Buisnes.</li><li>Coordinates with other departments and facilities the implementation, development, and improvement of new and old programs tooling requirements. </li><li>Coordinates the fabrication of all required tooling and equipment to support old and new programs.</li><li>Coordinates and implements engineering changes on new and existing tooled programs.</li><li>Develop and maintains a tooling manual for best practices and new innovations.</li><li>Develop and manage a tooling tracker and reports out accordingly with the tooling engineer from S.P. divisions</li><li>Manage Tooling Data base(TLDB) with Tooling engineers for accuracy.</li><li>Acts as technical contact for vendors on tooling issues.</li><li>Develops and maintains all tooling progress reports.</li><li>Coordinates FMEA on all new tooling.</li><li>Ensures company guidelines for part scrap are adhered to during tooling design process.</li><li>Reviews &amp;
